pages.title: Whale Fittings
pages.text: Find a Widget in shipwreck supply loot, install it on Hullback and operate its cannon or anchor.

pages.title: Whale Fittings
pages.text: A sail extends the living ship’s fittings and gunpowder supplies further permitted cannon use.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Widgets such as sails and cannons come from native exploration loot. Cannons use gunpowder; Helm jump controls activate the supported widget, including an anchor. One working widget is enough.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Search shipwreck supplies for Widgets such as sails and cannons, then install them. Buried treasure does not provide this Widget route.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Load gunpowder into a cannon and fire using jump; use the Helm's jump control for an installed anchor. Widgets add player-operated weapons and mooring controls.
